title: Sense Through the Force
text: Choose a number, then search the top 5 cards of your deck for a card, reveal it, and draw it. If its cost is the chosen number, you may give 3 Advantage tokens to a Force unit.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
After searching, put any cards not chosen on the bottom of your deck in a random order.
